Excuse me, sir. Where is the metro station?
It is on this street, next to the big church.
Is it near? We have our bags with us.
Very near. Two minutes. There is a map here, on the wall.
Thank you. And is there a restaurant near here?
There are two restaurants on this street. One is between the hotel and the station.
Perfect. One more question. Where is the bathroom?
There is one in the restaurant, but it is for clients. There is a public one in the park.
In the park. Is the park on this street too?
No, it is not. It is at the end of the street, on the left.
Thank you very much. You are very kind.

Hello, and welcome to Hotel Le Marais. This is a short message about the hotel and about the street. Your room is on the third floor, next to the elevator. There is a bathroom in every room, and there are towels in the closet. Breakfast is in the small room on the first floor, from seven to ten. There is a metro station near the hotel, only two minutes on foot. There are three restaurants on this street, and one of them is between the hotel and the park. The map of Paris is at the reception. Please ask for it. Thank you, and have a very good day in Paris.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Saint-Paul station. My name is Camille, and I work here. Please listen for one minute. This is line one. The train to the Louvre is on platform two, and the train to the airport is on platform four. There is a bathroom near the exit, on the left. There are two machines for tickets between the two platforms. If you have a question, I am here, at the desk, near the map. Have a very good trip today.
